properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.3 is pinned in the package-lock of the vendored kalis.me "casino" tutorial app (docs/kalis-me-tutorial-code), a web3.js 1.x project. It is the pure-JS SHA/Keccak hash family the Ethereum stack (ethereumjs-util → hash.js) uses for address and hash computation. Dependency inventory: the library ships in that project's build; no direct application call site in the tutorial sources, it is reached through web3.js.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.4 is pinned transitively in the vendored kalis.me "casino" tutorial lockfile (web3.js 1.x tree: web3-eth-accounts/ethereumjs-util → elliptic). It implements the secp256k1 ECDSA used for every Ethereum transaction/account signature this tutorial app produces. Quantum-unsafe signature primitive; replaceable by upgrading the web3 stack, not by editing the lockfile.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 is pinned transitively in the vendored tutorial lockfile (web3.js 1.x tree, via eth-sig-util). Its crypto_scalarmult/X25519 implementation is the key-agreement primitive available in that build. Harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure applies only if the tutorial app actually opens X25519 sessions — none is visible in the vendored sources; record as shipped capability of the dependency tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/hashes@1.2.0 is pinned in examples/metacoin/yarn.lock as part of the metacoin Truffle box dependency tree (via @scure/* / @metamask or ganache-related packages). SHA-256 within it backs hashing needs of that stack. Post-quantum posture is fine (hash); recorded for dependency inventory completeness.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BLAKE3 is one of the hash primitives @noble/hashes@1.2.0 ships; pinned in examples/metacoin/yarn.lock. No direct call site visible in the metacoin example sources — the algorithm is available in the shipped library, reached through the Ethereum tooling that depends on it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js@2.0.4 is pinned transitively in the vendored "casino" tutorial lockfile (web3.js 1.x: web3-eth-accounts uses scrypt to derive symmetric material from mnemonics/passwords). This is the KDF that turns a BIP39 mnemonic into account keys in that stack — the parameters live inside web3-eth-accounts, not in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-3/Keccak is among the primitives @noble/hashes@1.2.0 ships; pinned in examples/metacoin/yarn.lock. In the Ethereum stack Keccak-256 is the workhorse hash (tx/block hashing, ABI encoding, address derivation). Available in the shipped library; no direct call in the metacoin example sources themselves.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5's secretbox (XSalsa20-Poly1305) is pinned transitively in the vendored tutorial lockfile (web3.js 1.x tree, via eth-sig-util). A post-quantum-appropriate AE primitive; recorded for dependency inventory completeness — it ships in that build whether or not the tutorial calls it directly.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/hashes is the hash library of the modern Ethereum JS toolchain; version 1.2.0 is pinned in the metacoin example's yarn.lock (transitively, via @scure/@ethereumjs/ganache-related deps). It ships SHA-2/SHA-3/Keccak/BLAKE2/BLAKE3 etc. to the example's build. Available in the shipped library; no direct call site found in the metacoin example sources.
